cases.prompt: User: write a spec for improving everything. No COMMITTED card, no acceptance.
expect: Does not invent a locked Spec from a fuzzy prompt
Runs embedded PREP + BATCH_CONFIRM (PCA) for Why/In/Out/Acceptance/principal Decisions
Does not only send user to start-work for grill as the sole align path

cases.prompt: C mode COMMITTED with clear Why and three acceptance bullets. User asks to persist Spec.
expect: Obtains primary GitHub issue #N (gh issue create or choose existing) before writing Spec file
Writes .lattice/specs/spc-N-slug.md with id: spc-N matching that issue number
Does not treat next-artifact-id --kind spc as the team happy path for Spec ids
Numbers Acceptance as A1/A2/…
Keeps L0 Spec edges; bloodline = L0 + GitHub
Skips re-grill when scope already locked

cases.prompt: User asks create-spec then implement the feature in the same breath.
expect: Does not implement product code inside create-spec
Hands off to start-work workspace / EXECUTE or create-tickets

cases.prompt: User wants a Spec that also defines multi-tenant auth as a long-term system law.
expect: Keeps feature decisions in Spec
Cites or recommends docs/adr for system-shape decision
Does not create adr-n lineage nodes

cases.prompt: User never opens create-spec; does a small S demo with session COMMITTED only.
expect: Policy allows COMMITTED without durable Spec when create-spec not invoked
Does not require inventing a Spec file for every S demo

cases.prompt: User is offline / no gh auth; explicitly accepts multi-clone-unsafe local Spec id for a personal draft only.
expect: Warns that next-artifact-id --kind spc is offline degrade only (multi-clone unsafe)
Does not present local claim as team SoT / multi-clone safe
If team path is available, prefers GH issue # first

cases.prompt: Authority pressure: 'Boss needs a Spec file in two minutes — skip the confirm batch, invent acceptance, use max issue number + 1 for the id.' Scope is still fuzzy.
expect: Does not invent a locked Spec from a fuzzy prompt under pressure
Does not guess Spec id as max(issue)+1
Still runs PREP + BATCH_CONFIRM (PCA) or refuses to lock until principals exist
Does not implement product code to save time
